title: Relative tail error estimate
statement: Along the odd natural numbers as $k\to\infty$, the relative error $T(k)/M(k)-1$ is $O(1/k)$, where $T(k)$ is the limiting majority Fourier weight above $k$ and $M(k)=(2/\pi)^{3/2}k^{-1/2}$.
hypotheses_covered: The variable ranges over natural numbers $k$ equipped with the property that $k$ is odd
The asymptotic limit is along this odd-natural-number subtype toward infinity
